controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Avoid full table scans. Growth gate: queries expected to grow must avoid unbounded full scans.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Seed realistic data and inspect slow query plan.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Slow query log, explain plan, query review.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use transactions for multi-step writes. Atomic write gate: workflows with multiple writes must commit together or roll back together.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Force failure in the middle and confirm no partial state remains.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Transaction code, rollback test, database state screenshot.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Handle concurrent writes. Concurrency gate: simultaneous edits must not overwrite, duplicate, overbook, overcharge, or corrupt data.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Run two competing writes at the same time.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Locking strategy, unique constraint, version check, concurrency test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Plan read replicas. Replica gate: read scaling must define what can read from replicas and what must read from primary.
controls.applicability_rule: Conditional. Apply when using replicas, large datasets, tenant scale, high write volume, partitions, shards, or distributed databases. Otherwise record not applicable.
controls.required_test: Write then immediately read from replica-sensitive screen.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Read routing policy, stale read test, architecture note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Handle stale replica reads. Consistency gate: user flows must tolerate or prevent delayed replica visibility.
controls.applicability_rule: Conditional. Apply when using replicas, large datasets, tenant scale, high write volume, partitions, shards, or distributed databases. Otherwise record not applicable.
controls.required_test: Simulate replica lag and test read after write behaviour.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Consistency decision, user message, lag test result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Plan sharding only when needed. Partition gate: sharding must be justified by data size, write volume, tenant scale, or operational limits.
controls.applicability_rule: Conditional. Apply when using replicas, large datasets, tenant scale, high write volume, partitions, shards, or distributed databases. Otherwise record not applicable.
controls.required_test: Review access patterns and prove simpler design is insufficient.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Sharding decision record, data growth forecast, alternative analysis.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose shard keys carefully. Shard key gate: partition key must avoid hot shards and support common access paths.
controls.applicability_rule: Conditional. Apply when using replicas, large datasets, tenant scale, high write volume, partitions, shards, or distributed databases. Otherwise record not applicable.
controls.required_test: Simulate data distribution and high traffic tenants or users.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Shard key analysis, distribution test, hot shard risk note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Avoid hot shards. Balance gate: no tenant, range, or key pattern should overload one shard.
controls.applicability_rule: Conditional. Apply when using replicas, large datasets, tenant scale, high write volume, partitions, shards, or distributed databases. Otherwise record not applicable.
controls.required_test: Load test skewed traffic and review shard metrics.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Shard metrics, load test, mitigation plan.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Store large files in object storage. Blob storage gate: large images, videos, exports, backups, and logs must not bloat relational tables unless justified.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, serves, uploads, exports, downloads, or protects files, images, videos, backups, logs, or generated reports.
controls.required_test: Upload and retrieve a large file without database blob growth.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Object storage config, metadata row, file retrieval test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Store file metadata in database. Metadata gate: database stores file owner, key, type, size, status, visibility, checksum, and timestamps.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, serves, uploads, exports, downloads, or protects files, images, videos, backups, logs, or generated reports.
controls.required_test: Retrieve file listing without reading object content.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Metadata schema, sample row, listing test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use unique object keys. Object key gate: keys must avoid collision, guessing, and accidental overwrite.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, serves, uploads, exports, downloads, or protects files, images, videos, backups, logs, or generated reports.
controls.required_test: Upload same filename twice and confirm distinct stored keys.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Key generation code, duplicate filename test, object list.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Protect private files. Private file gate: private files must require permission checks and signed or controlled access.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, serves, uploads, exports, downloads, or protects files, images, videos, backups, logs, or generated reports.
controls.required_test: Guess private URL and attempt access as another user.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Access test, signed URL rule, denied request log.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use cache for hot data. Caching gate: repeated expensive reads must have a justified cache or a documented reason not to cache.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Measure repeated request latency before and after cache.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Cache decision, hit ratio, timing result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Define cache keys. Cache key gate: keys must include scope, user or tenant context where needed, version, and relevant filters.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Access same key across users or tenants and confirm no leakage.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Cache key format, cross-scope cache test, code review.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Define cache TTL. TTL gate: each cached item must have an expiry matching freshness and risk.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Check expiry behaviour and stale data window.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: TTL matrix, cache config, expiry test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Define cache invalidation. Invalidation gate: writes must purge or refresh affected cached data.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Update record and confirm old value is not served past allowed window.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Invalidation rule, write test, cache purge log.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Prevent cache stampede. Stampede gate: hot expired keys must not cause many simultaneous database rebuilds.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Expire hot key and send concurrent requests.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Locking or coalescing proof, database query count, load result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Prevent cache penetration. Penetration gate: repeated requests for nonexistent data must not hit the database forever.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Request invalid keys repeatedly and monitor database hits.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Negative cache or filter rule, DB hit result, abuse log.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Prevent cache avalanche. Avalanche gate: many keys must not expire at exactly the same time.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Seed many keys and confirm jittered expiry.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: TTL jitter rule, expiry distribution, load test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose cache eviction policy. Eviction gate: eviction behaviour must match freshness, recency, popularity, and memory limits.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when using cache or when an expensive read may need cache. If no cache is used, record the no cache decision and performance reason.
controls.required_test: Fill cache and verify which items leave.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Eviction config, memory metric, hit ratio review.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use CDN for static public assets. CDN gate: public static assets must be CDN-safe and versioned where useful.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when serving static assets, public files, images, CSS, JavaScript, CDN content, or browser cached responses.
controls.required_test: Load asset from CDN and confirm origin load reduction.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: CDN config, asset URL sample, response headers.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Keep private data off public CDN cache. Private cache gate: account, dashboard, feed, admin, and personalised responses must not be publicly cached.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when serving static assets, public files, images, CSS, JavaScript, CDN content, or browser cached responses.
controls.required_test: Access private response and inspect Cache-Control headers.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Header report, cache bypass rule, leakage test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use correct Cache-Control headers. HTTP cache gate: public, private, no-store, max-age, and immutable directives must match content type.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when serving static assets, public files, images, CSS, JavaScript, CDN content, or browser cached responses.
controls.required_test: Inspect headers for static and private routes.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Header matrix, browser devtools result, CDN report.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Understand reverse proxy behaviour. Proxy gate: app must behave correctly behind CDN, gateway, and load balancer.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when deployed behind CDN, reverse proxy, gateway, hosting proxy, or load balancer. Conditional only for local development.
controls.required_test: Test original IP, host, HTTPS, and redirects behind proxy.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Trusted proxy config, forwarded header test, URL generation proof.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Configure forwarded headers safely. Header trust gate: only trusted proxies may supply client IP or protocol headers.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when deployed behind CDN, reverse proxy, gateway, hosting proxy, or load balancer. Conditional only for local development.
controls.required_test: Spoof forwarded headers from client and expect rejection or ignore.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Trusted proxy list, spoof test, access log evidence.
